sloka: स शास्ति चिरम् ऐश्वर्यम् अरीम्श्च कुरुते वशे ।सम्दधानो हि कालेन विगृह्णम्सः चारिभिः सह ॥६-३५-८॥।।
transliteration: sa śāsti ciram aiśvaryam arīmśca kurute vaśe ।samdadhāno hi kālena vigṛhṇamsaḥ cāribhiḥ saha ॥6-35-8॥।।

translations.english: "Continuing to act in that way in course of time a king who encounters his enemies and expands his own side, enjoys great sovereignty."
